season.sr: Sezona kupanja traje otprilike od maja do oktobra; mnogi hoteli i taverne zimi rade u smanjenom obimu.
season.en: The beach season runs roughly May to October; many hotels and tavernas scale back in winter.

tagline.sr: Tri zelena prsta s plitkim peščanim plažama i borovim šumama.
tagline.en: Three green fingers of peninsula with shallow sandy beaches and pine forests.

description.sr: Poluostrvo s tri kraka – Kasandra, Sitonija i Atos – poznato po plitkim peščanim plažama, čistom moru i borovima koji silaze do vode. Za porodice su najbolji Kasandra i Sitonija, s brojnim apartmanima i hotelima tik uz plažu. More je ovde najčešće mirno i plitko, pa deca mogu dugo da se brčkaju bezbedno.
description.en: A three-fingered peninsula – Kassandra, Sithonia and Athos – known for shallow sandy beaches, clear water and pine trees that reach down to the shore. Kassandra and Sithonia are the best fit for families, with plenty of apartments and hotels right on the beach. The sea is usually calm and shallow, so little ones can splash around safely for ages.

highlights.sr: Plitke peščane plaže poput Kanjotija (Chanioti) i Jerakinija
highlights.en: Shallow sandy beaches such as Chanioti and Yerakini

highlights.sr: Izleti brodićem do obližnjih uvala i plaža
highlights.en: Boat trips to nearby coves and beaches

highlights.sr: Šetnje kroz borove šume koje hlade i u julu
highlights.en: Walks through pine forests that give shade even in July

pros.sr: Plitko i mirno more, idealno za malu decu
pros.en: Shallow, calm sea – ideal for small children

pros.sr: Kratak transfer iz Soluna i veliki izbor porodičnih smeštaja
pros.en: Short transfer from Thessaloniki and a wide choice of family lodging

pros.sr: Povoljna hrana i smeštaj u poređenju s ostrvima
pros.en: Good value food and lodging compared with the islands

cons.sr: Jul i avgust su vrući i krcati
cons.en: July and August are hot and packed

cons.sr: Bez automobila je teško obići tri poluostrva
cons.en: Hard to explore the three peninsulas without a car

cons.en: Some beaches are pebbly rather than sandy

tip.sr: Idite u maju, junu ili septembru i uzmite smeštaj tik uz plažu – uštedećete svako nošenje opreme.
tip.en: Go in May, June or September and book right on the beach – you'll save yourself carrying gear every day.

season.sr: Sezona kupanja traje od maja do oktobra; ostrvo i stari grad žive tokom cele godine.
season.en: Beach season runs May to October; the island and its old town are alive all year round.

tagline.sr: Zeleno ostrvo s uvalama, UNESCO starim gradom i dve tvrđave.
tagline.en: A green island of coves, a UNESCO old town and two fortresses.

description.sr: Krf je jedno od najzelenijih grčkih ostrva, s peščanim i šljunkovitim uvalama na zapadu i živim starim gradom na istoku. Za porodice je zlata vredna kratka vožnja od aerodroma do hotela. Dan provedite na plaži u Paleokastrici ili Glifadi, a veče u starom gradu s dve mletačke tvrđave.
description.en: Corfu is one of the greenest Greek islands, with sandy and pebbly coves in the west and a lively old town in the east. The short drive from the airport to your hotel is gold for families. Spend the day on the beach at Paleokastritsa or Glyfada, and the evening in the old town with its two Venetian fortresses.

highlights.en: The emerald coves of Paleokastritsa

highlights.sr: UNESCO stari grad i Stara tvrđava
highlights.en: The UNESCO old town and the Old Fortress
The Canal d'Amour in Sidari

pros.sr: Aerodrom je 10 minuta od grada – brzo stižete do smeštaja
pros.en: The airport is 10 minutes from town – you get to your bed fast

pros.sr: Zeleno ostrvo puno hlada, s lepim peščanim plažama
pros.en: A green, shady island with lovely sandy beaches

tip.sr: Uzmite smeštaj u blizini Paleokastrice i dolazite u stari grad rano ujutru, pre gužve i vrućine.
tip.en: Stay near Paleokastritsa and visit the old town early in the morning, before the crowds and heat.

season.sr: Krit ima najdužu sezonu u Grčkoj – kupati se može od aprila do oktobra, a u maju i septembru je najprijatnije.
season.en: Crete has Greece's longest season – you can swim from April to October, and May and September are the most pleasant.

tagline.sr: Najveće grčko ostrvo: Knosos, tvrđava Kules i dugačke plitke plaže.
tagline.en: Greece's biggest island: Knossos, the Koules fortress and long shallow beaches.

description.sr: Iraklion je dobra baza za prvi porodični boravak na Kritu: aerodrom je uz sam grad, a u blizini su plitke plaže poput Stalisa i Amoudare. Za jedan izlet isplati se otići do Knososa, palate cara Minosa, koju deca doživljavaju kao pravi lavirint. Uz more, grad nudi tvrđavu Kules i živu luku.
description.en: Heraklion is a good base for a first family stay on Crete: the airport is right by the city, and shallow beaches like Stalis and Amoudara are close. It's worth one outing to Knossos, the palace of King Minos, which children experience as a real labyrinth. By the sea, the city offers the Koules fortress and a lively harbour.

highlights.en: The palace of Knossos – a labyrinth with frescoes
The Koules fortress and the old harbour
The shallow beaches of Stalis and Amoudara
The Cretaquarium aquarium

pros.sr: Duga sezona i blaga klima u maju, septembru i oktobru
pros.en: A long season and a mild climate in May, September and October

pros.sr: Spoj plaže i istorije (Knosos, Kules) na jednom mestu
pros.en: Beach and history (Knossos, Koules) in one place

tip.en: Visit Knossos early morning or late afternoon with hats and water – it's scorching in summer.

season.sr: Sezona kupanja traje od maja do oktobra; stari grad i muzeji rade tokom cele godine.
season.en: The beach season runs May to October; the old town and museums are open year-round.

tagline.sr: Ostrvo vitezova: srednjovekovni stari grad, Lindos i plitke plaže.
tagline.en: Island of the Knights: a medieval old town, Lindos and shallow beaches.

description.sr: Rodos je savršen spoj kulture i plaže. Stari grad, pod zaštitom UNESCO-a, pravi je srednjovekovni grad unutar zidina u koji deca ulaze kao u bajku. Na istočnoj obali su duge peščane plaže s plitkim morem, a južnije se nalazi belo selo Lindos s akropoljem iznad uvale.
description.en: Rhodes is the perfect mix of culture and beach. The UNESCO-listed old town is a real medieval walled city that children enter like a fairy tale. The east coast has long sandy beaches with shallow water, and further south lies the white village of Lindos with its acropolis above the bay.

highlights.sr: Srednjovekovni stari grad pod zaštitom UNESCO-a
highlights.en: The UNESCO-listed medieval old town

highlights.sr: Belo selo Lindos i njegov akropolj

highlights.sr: Plitke peščane plaže na istočnoj obali
highlights.en: Shallow sandy beaches on the east coast

pros.en: A short airport transfer and plenty of family hotels

pros.sr: Stari grad i plaža su udaljeni desetak minuta
pros.en: The old town and beach are ten minutes apart

season.en: The beach season runs May to October; the airport is small and mostly summer-only, so off-season you often fly via Athens.

tagline.sr: Duge plitke peščane plaže i Portara na zalasku sunca.
tagline.en: Long shallow sandy beaches and the Portara at sunset.

description.sr: Naksos je najveće ostrvo Kiklada i mirnija, povoljnija alternativa Santoriniju i Mikonosu. Plaže Agios Prokopios i Agia Ana su duge, peščane i plitke – idealne za bebe i male plivače. U gradu Hora, deca vole veliki kameni „Portara" – ostatak Apolonovog hrama uz more.
description.en: Naxos is the largest Cycladic island and a calmer, better-value alternative to Santorini and Mykonos. The beaches of Agios Prokopios and Agia Anna are long, sandy and shallow – ideal for babies and small swimmers. In the town of Chora, children love the great stone "Portara" – the remains of Apollo's temple by the sea.

highlights.en: Agios Prokopios beach – long and shallow
The Portara – gate of the temple of Apollo

highlights.sr: Stari grad Hora i gradski kej
highlights.en: The old town of Chora and the waterfront

pros.en: Long sandy beaches with shallow water

pros.sr: Opušteno i povoljnije od Santorinija i Mikonosa
pros.en: Relaxed and better value than Santorini and Mykonos

pros.en: Flat coastal paths that are easy for walking and buggies

season.en: The beach season runs May to October; out of season the town is quiet and much is closed.

tagline.sr: Šareni gradić na kopnu s Valtos plažom i izletima do Paksosa.
tagline.en: A colourful mainland town with Valtos beach and boat trips to Paxos.

description.sr: Parga je jedan od najlepših gradića jonske obale, na kopnu – do njega se može i kolima. Šarene kuće se penju uz brdo do tvrđave, a ispod grada je plaža Valtos s plitkim morem. Brodićem se za dan obiđu uvalice Sivote ili ostrva Paksos i Antipaksos s kristalno čistim morem.
description.en: Parga is one of the loveliest towns on the Ionian coast, on the mainland – you can even drive to it. Colourful houses climb the hill to the castle, and below the town lies Valtos beach with its shallow water. By boat you can reach the coves of Syvota or the islands of Paxos and Antipaxos with crystal-clear sea in a day.

highlights.en: Valtos beach with its shallow water
The castle and colourful streets of Parga

highlights.sr: Izlet brodićem do Paksosa i Sivote
highlights.en: Boat trips to Paxos and Syvota

tagline.sr: Ravno ostrvo za vožnju biciklom, s plitkim plažama i tvrđavom.
tagline.en: A flat island for cycling, with shallow beaches and a fortress.

description.sr: Kos je jedno od najravnijih grčkih ostrva, što ga čini idealnim za porodice – duž obale vode duge biciklističke staze koje deca obožavaju. Grad Kos ima tvrđavu i živ stari grad, a plaže Marmari i Tigaki su peščane i plitke. U blizini je i veliki vodeni park za toplije dane.
description.en: Kos is one of Greece's flattest islands, which makes it ideal for families – long cycle paths run along the coast and children love them. Kos town has a fortress and a lively old town, and the beaches of Marmari and Tigaki are sandy and shallow. A large water park is nearby for the hotter days.

highlights.en: Cycle paths along the flat coast
Kos's fortress and old town
The sandy beaches of Marmari and Tigaki

season.sr: Sezona kupanja traje od maja do oktobra; trajekt plovi cele godine, ali zimi ređe.
season.en: The beach season runs May to October; the ferry runs year-round but less often in winter.

tagline.sr: Zeleno severno ostrvo sa Zlatnom plažom i mermernim liticama.
tagline.en: A green northern island with Golden Beach and marble cliffs.

description.sr: Tasos je najsevernije grčko ostrvo, blizu obale, pa se do njega stiže kratkim trajektom iz Keramotija. Zlatna plaža (Hrisi Amudija) je dugačka, peščana i izuzetno plitka – deca tu mogu da gacaju daleko od obale. Ostrvo je gusto pošumljeno borovima, što leti donosi dragocen hlad.
description.en: Thassos is Greece's northernmost island, close to the mainland, so you reach it by a short ferry from Keramoti. Golden Beach (Chrysi Ammoudia) is long, sandy and extremely shallow – children can wade far out from the shore. The island is thickly forested with pines, which brings precious shade in summer.

description.sr: Zoomarine je morski tematski park blizu Albufeire, u borovoj šumi nadomak mora. Deca najviše vole predstave delfina i morskih lavova, akvarijum i veliki talasni bazen s veštačkom peščanom plažom. Postoji i centar za rehabilitaciju morskih životinja, pa je poseta i edukativna.
description.en: Zoomarine is a marine theme park near Albufeira, in a pine forest close to the sea. Children love the dolphin and sea lion shows, the aquarium and the big wave pool with an artificial sandy beach. There is also a marine animal rehabilitation centre, so the visit is educational too.

tagline.sr: Šest tematskih svetova, dečja zona Sesame i vodeni park pored mora.
tagline.en: Six themed worlds, a Sesame Street kids' area and a water park by the sea.

description.sr: PortAventura je jedan od najvećih tematskih parkova Evrope, u Salouu na Kosta Doradi. Iako je poznat po velikim rolerkosterima, ima i odličnu dečju zonu Sesame s vrtuljcima i igralištima za najmlađe, kao i vodeni park Caribe Aquatic. Uz park se nalaze tematski hoteli, a more je pet minuta dalje.
description.en: PortAventura is one of Europe's biggest theme parks, in Salou on the Costa Dorada. Though famous for its big roller coasters, it also has an excellent Sesame Street kids' area with gentle rides and playgrounds for the youngest, plus the Caribe Aquatic water park. Themed hotels sit beside the park, and the sea is five minutes away.

tagline.sr: Dugačak zaliv Alkudije s najplićim morem i zidinama starog grada.
tagline.en: The long bay of Alcúdia with the shallowest water and a walled old town.

description.sr: Zaliv Alkudije na severu Majorke nudi kilometre plitke peščane plaže (Alkudija i Plaja de Muro) gde deca mogu da gacaju daleko od obale. Iza plaže je srednjovekovni grad Alkudija sa zidinama, a u blizini je i prirodni park S'Albufera za šetnje i posmatranje ptica.
description.en: The bay of Alcúdia in northern Mallorca offers kilometres of shallow sandy beach (Alcúdia and Playa de Muro) where children can wade far out from the shore. Behind the beach is the medieval walled town of Alcúdia, and nearby is the S'Albufera nature park for walks and birdwatching.

highlights.sr: Plitka plaža Plaja de Muro i Alkudija
highlights.en: The shallow beaches of Playa de Muro and Alcúdia
The medieval walled town of Alcúdia
The S'Albufera nature park

pros.sr: Vrlo plitko i mirno more u dugačkom zalivu
pros.en: Very shallow, calm water in a long bay

pros.sr: Duga šetališta uz plažu, idealna za kolica
pros.en: Long promenades by the beach, ideal for buggies

pros.sr: Odlična infrastruktura za porodice
pros.en: Excellent family infrastructure

cons.sr: Jul i avgust su gužva i vrućina
cons.en: July and August bring crowds and heat

cons.sr: Severna obala ume da bude vetrovita
cons.en: The north coast can be windy

cons.sr: Velika turistička zona uz plažu
cons.en: A large tourist zone along the beach

tip.sr: Birajte smeštaj uz Plaja de Muro i ponesite zaštitu od vetra – plaža je blaga, ali vetar zna da ohladi veče.
tip.en: Stay along Playa de Muro and bring a windbreak – the beach is gentle but the evening wind can chill.

season.sr: Park je otvoren otprilike od aprila do oktobra, ponekad i tokom zime; zimi i rano proleće je zatvoren.
season.en: The park is open roughly April to October, sometimes also in winter; it closes over winter and early spring.

tagline.sr: Italija u umanjenom obliku: 270 maketa spomenika u jednom parku.
tagline.en: Italy in miniature: 270 scale models of monuments in one park.

description.sr: Italija u malom je park u riminijskom predgrađu Viserba, s više od 270 vernih maketa italijanskih spomenika i gradova, uključujući i malu Veneciju s kanalom. Deca se voze minijaturnim vozom, gledaju makete u pokretu i uče o Italiji kroz igru. Za najmlađe postoji i dečja zona s ljuljaškama.
description.en: Italia in Miniatura is a park in the Rimini suburb of Viserba, with more than 270 faithful scale models of Italian monuments and cities, including a mini Venice with a canal. Children ride a miniature train, watch the models come alive and learn about Italy through play. There's a play area with swings for the youngest.

highlights.en: 270 scale models of Italian monuments
A ride on the miniature train through the park
The mini Venice with its canal

pros.sr: Ravne staze prilagođene kolicima
pros.en: Flat, buggy-friendly paths

pros.sr: Deca do 1 m visine ulaze besplatno
pros.en: Children up to 1 m tall enter free

pros.sr: Mirnija i povoljnija alternativa velikim parkovima
pros.en: A calmer, better-value alternative to the big parks

cons.sr: Park je najvećim delom na otvorenom – za vrućih dana nema mnogo hlada
cons.en: Mostly open-air – little shade on hot days

cons.sr: Zatvoren tokom zime i ranog proleća
cons.en: Closed over winter and early spring

cons.sr: Makete su krhke – decu treba paziti
cons.en: The models are fragile – children need watching

tip.sr: Dođite rano ujutru i ponesite kape i vodu; park se najlepše obilazi pre podnevne vrućine.
tip.en: Arrive early with hats and water; the park is best explored before the midday heat.

name.sr: Italija u malom – dnevna karta (deca do 1 m besplatna)
name.en: Italia in Miniatura day ticket (children under 1 m free)

season.sr: Park je otvoren svakodnevno od marta do početka novembra (10–18 h); zimi radi samo vikendom.
season.en: The park is open daily from March to early November (10 am–6 pm); in winter it's weekends only.

tagline.sr: Park posvećen Pinokiju u toskanskom selu Kolodi, među skulpturama i vrtovima.
tagline.en: A park dedicated to Pinocchio in the Tuscan village of Collodi, among sculptures and gardens.

description.sr: Park Pinokija je otvoreni muzej u toskanskom selu Kolodi, rodnom kraju pisca Karla Kolodija. Kroz park su razmeštene skulpture i mozaici koji prate priču o Pinokiju, a deca vole i veliku drvenu statuu Pinokija. Uz njega se nalazi istorijski vrt Garzoni s leptirima, pa je ovo miran, bajkovit izlet.
description.en: Pinocchio Park is an open-air museum in the Tuscan village of Collodi, the birthplace region of writer Carlo Collodi. Sculptures and mosaics throughout the park tell the story of Pinocchio, and children love the great wooden Pinocchio statue. The historic Garzoni garden with its butterfly house sits alongside, making this a gentle, fairy-tale outing.

highlights.sr: Skulpture i mozaici iz priče o Pinokiju
highlights.en: Sculptures and mosaics from the Pinocchio story
The great wooden Pinocchio statue
The Garzoni garden and butterfly house

pros.sr: Miran i bajkovit, bez vrisaka i velikih gužvi
pros.en: Calm and fairy-tale-like, without noise and big crowds

pros.sr: Deca do 3 godine ulaze besplatno
pros.en: Children under 3 enter free

pros.sr: Blizu Luke i Pize – lako se kombinuje s razgledanjem
pros.en: Near Lucca and Pisa – easy to combine with sightseeing

cons.sr: Park je na padini – staze su strme za kolica
cons.en: The park is on a slope – paths are steep for buggies

cons.sr: Manje klasičnih vožnji – više šetnja i razgledanje
cons.en: Few classic rides – more walking and looking

cons.sr: Nema mnogo hlada u letnjim mesecima
cons.en: Little shade in the summer months

tip.sr: Kombinujte posetu s jutrom u Luki i ponesite lagana kolica – deo parka je na strmini.
tip.en: Combine the visit with a morning in Lucca and bring a light buggy – part of the park is on a slope.

name.sr: Park Pinokija + vrt Garzoni (deca do 3 godine besplatna)
name.en: Pinocchio Park + Garzoni Garden (children under 3 free)

season.sr: Letnje žičare rade otprilike od kraja maja do početka novembra; zimi je plato skijaško područje.
season.en: The summer cable cars run roughly late May to early November; in winter the plateau is a ski area.

tagline.sr: Najveća alpska livada Evrope: ravne staze, krave i Dolomiti u pozadini.
tagline.en: Europe's largest alpine meadow: flat paths, cows and the Dolomites behind.

description.sr: Seiser Alm (Alpe di Siusi) je ogroman, blago zatalasan planinski plato na visini oko 1.700 metara u Dolomitima. To je jedno od najlakših mesta za boravak s malom decom u planinama: staze su ravne i široke, a iz Compatscha kreću šetnje uz ograde i alpske kolibe. Leti se gore stiže žičarom ili, rano ujutru, kolima.
description.en: Seiser Alm (Alpe di Siusi) is a vast, gently rolling mountain plateau at about 1,700 m in the Dolomites. It's one of the easiest places to be in the mountains with small children: the paths are flat and wide, and walks lead out from Compatsch past fences and alpine huts. In summer you go up by cable car or, early in the morning, by car.

highlights.sr: Ravne šetnje od Compatscha s pogledom na Dolomite
highlights.en: Flat walks from Compatsch with Dolomite views

highlights.sr: Alpske kolibe s domaćom hranom i igralištima
highlights.en: Alpine huts with local food and playgrounds

highlights.sr: Vožnja žičarom i susret s kravama na pašnjacima
highlights.en: A cable-car ride and cows on the pastures

pros.sr: Ravne, široke staze – odlične za kolica i male noge
pros.en: Flat, wide paths – great for buggies and little legs

pros.sr: Svež planinski vazduh i hlad u borovim šumama
pros.en: Fresh mountain air and shade in the pine forests

pros.sr: Porodična infrastruktura i igrališta uz kolibe
pros.en: Family facilities and playgrounds by the huts

cons.sr: Žičare i smeštaj u Južnom Tirolu su skupi
cons.en: Cable cars and lodging in South Tyrol are pricey

cons.sr: Danju se kolima ne sme gore – mora se žičarom ili rano ujutru
cons.en: Cars aren't allowed up during the day – you need the cable car or an early start

cons.sr: Na visini je – osetljivijoj deci treba dan-dva privikavanja
cons.en: It's high altitude – sensitive children may need a day or two to adjust

tip.sr: Idite gore prvom žičarom ili autom pre 9 ujutru, kad je plato miran, i ponesite slojevitu odeću.
tip.en: Go up on the first cable car or drive up before 9 am when the plateau is quiet, and bring layers.
